title: E0097: Cookie Without HttpOnly Flag
plain_english: Setting a cookie without the `HttpOnly` flag allows it to be accessed by JavaScript, which increases the impact of XSS vulnerabilities.
why_matters: Without the `HttpOnly` flag: - Session cookies can be stolen by malicious JavaScript - XSS attacks can exfiltrate authentication tokens - Attackers can hijack user sessions
what_it_checks: `setcookie()` or `setrawcookie()` calls where `httponly` is not set to `true`
